name: dsh-org-talent
description: Organization-wide employee matching in the DSH left sidebar: a project guide with progress and alerts, a reusable requirement pool, a workspace that turns a project into member tasks and opens the project's DSH conversation, a searchable talent pool, an org chart, team recommendations, capability advice, a skill-center training planner with GitHub skill research, and project feedback. Import CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown or XLSX. · 左侧栏的组织人才匹配：项目导览与预警、可复用需求池、工作区任务与项目对话、人才库、组织架构、全组织团队匹配、能力培养建议、技能中心培养计划与 GitHub 技能检索；支持多种文件导入。
